newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - JULY 25.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - JULY 25.

text.p: These are the main headlines on Hungary's Kossuth Radio midday news. Reuters cannot vouch for their accuracy:
- The Hungarian flag has been taken from the outside the newly-opened consulate in Cluj, in Romania.

- Florian Farkas, president of gypsy organisation Lungo Drom, said the government's acceptance on Thursday of a package of measures to improve conditions for Hungary's gypsy community was the first sign of pulling down the "Iron Curtain" of gypsy politics.

Christian Democrat MP Gyorgy Rubovszki, an opponent of president Gyorgy Giczy, has been expelled fron the Christian Democratic Party by the disciplinary committee. The committee session is continuing and more expulsions are expected.
Public officals will from September get their salaries no longer in cash but through a bank account.
Flood alerts along the Danube in Hungary have been reduced from the highest third degree to second degree.
